product: AI data center build-out: liquid cooling, cable management, engineered buildings and electrical enclosures (Systems Protection, Hoffman, Schroff); Maverick Power adds data-center switchgear and switchboards (2026-08-24). Power utilities are the second driver. Data center sales guided above $2 billion for 2026 (2026-07-31 transcript).
demand: Volume and new-product led. Q2 2026 organic sales rose 47%, with new products contributing over 30 points of growth (2026-07-31 transcript); price only offset inflation and tariffs (over $50M inflation, over $30M tariffs). Net price contribution was roughly nil, so growth is volume plus mix.
pricing_power: Tariffs and mix. 2026 tariff impact was raised to about $100M from $80M (2026-07-31 transcript). Electrical Connections return on sales fell 140bps to 27.3% on inflation and mix. A price war, or more large-project mix without productivity, is the collapse path; H2 assumes mid-20s incrementals.
competition: not found. No Chinese or low-cost substitute for nVent's liquid cooling or switchgear appears in the sources read; the filings cite only generic competition and pricing pressures and tariffs (2026-08-24 press release). No proximity-to-parity evidence was read.
market_strategy: Chair and CEO Beth Wozniak, 2026-07-31: we expect total data center sales more than $2 billion in 2026, more than double last year, and Blaine 2 opening H1 2027; FY2026 organic growth 32-34% and adjusted EPS $5.00-$5.10. On 2026-08-24 she called Maverick Power accretive to adjusted EPS in year one.
bull: Q2 2026 (2026-07-31): sales $1,471M +53%, organic +47%, adj EPS $1.45 +69%, ROS 21.9%; FY organic guided 32-34%; $2.5B backlog; Maverick Power adds data-center switchgear.
bear: Growth is volume/mix, price roughly nil; 2026 tariffs ~$100M; Electrical Connections ROS -140bps; $1.75B Maverick funded by $800M notes plus $600M term loan lifts leverage.
falsifier: Q3 2026 print on 2026-10-30 showing organic growth below 32% or adjusted EPS below $1.35, or gross margin below 36%.
web_what_changed_30_90d: Since the 2026-09-25 card: no new dated company event found. Last 30d: priced $800M 6.150% notes due 2036 on 2026-09-15 to fund the deal; declared $0.21 dividend 2026-09-21; Wells Fargo initiated Hold $182 on 2026-09-25. Last 90d: 2026-08-24 Maverick Power deal $1.75B; 2026-07-31 Q2 beat, FY organic guided 32-34%.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Deal funding is now committed: $800M notes plus a new $600M delayed-draw term loan and $250M revolver against a $1.75B price, so net leverage (1.2x at 2026-06-30) will step up. Notes redeem at 101% if Maverick does not close by 2026-11-20 (extendable to 2027-02-19). Short interest rose to 3.49M shares (2026-09-25).
web_demand_product: AI data center build-out: liquid cooling, cable management, engineered buildings and electrical enclosures (Systems Protection, Hoffman, Schroff); Maverick Power adds data-center switchgear and switchboards (2026-08-24). Power utilities are the second driver. Data center sales guided above $2 billion for 2026 (2026-07-31 transcript).
web_price_volume_mix: Volume and new-product led. Q2 2026 organic sales rose 47%, with new products contributing over 30 points of growth (2026-07-31 transcript); price only offset inflation and tariffs (over $50M inflation, over $30M tariffs). Net price contribution was roughly nil, so growth is volume plus mix.
web_bottleneck: nVent's own liquid-cooling capacity. Blaine 1 is ramping and Blaine 2, a similar-sized third facility, opens in H1 2027, lifting capacity about 60% and covering demand through 2027 into 2028 (2026-07-31 transcript). It relieves customers' constrained AI data-center power and cooling deployment.
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order: hyperscalers, neoclouds and multi-tenant operators that deploy AI compute faster, plus Minnesota suppliers and Maverick Power's roughly 900 employees (2026-08-24). Third-order: adjacent liquid-cooling, busbar and electrical-contractor vendors. Order backlog of $2.5B gives visibility into 2027 (2026-07-31 transcript).
web_who_loses: not found in sources read; no named loser. nVent's own risk factors cite competition and pricing pressures in the markets it serves (2026-08-24 press release), implying incumbent enclosure, liquid-cooling and switchgear rivals lose share as nVent wins.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Tariffs and mix. 2026 tariff impact was raised to about $100M from $80M (2026-07-31 transcript). Electrical Connections return on sales fell 140bps to 27.3% on inflation and mix. A price war, or more large-project mix without productivity, is the collapse path; H2 assumes mid-20s incrementals.
web_low_cost_substitute: not found. No Chinese or low-cost substitute for nVent's liquid cooling or switchgear appears in the sources read; the filings cite only generic competition and pricing pressures and tariffs (2026-08-24 press release). No proximity-to-parity evidence was read.
web_ceo_promised: Chair and CEO Beth Wozniak, 2026-07-31: we expect total data center sales more than $2 billion in 2026, more than double last year, and Blaine 2 opening H1 2027; FY2026 organic growth 32-34% and adjusted EPS $5.00-$5.10. On 2026-08-24 she called Maverick Power accretive to adjusted EPS in year one.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. Q2 2026 reported 2026-07-31: sales $1,471M, up 53% (47% organic); adjusted EPS $1.45, up 69%; return on sales 21.9% - well ahead of guidance, and full-year guidance was raised a second time. Systems Protection had its first above-$1B quarter, and EPG exceeded expectations.
web_what_would_falsify: Maverick Power failing to close by the 2026-11-20 outside date, or extending to 2027-02-19 (2026-09-15 press release). Also the Q3 2026 print near 2026-10-30 showing organic growth below the guided 32-35% or adjusted EPS below $1.35, or gross margin slipping below roughly 36% (2026-07-31 transcript).
